title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana + log shipping, dashboards, alerts for Private installs
author: Samira Patel
description: Motivation: private (VPC/on-prem) customers require a reproducible, audited observability stack as part of the private-installer. This PR automates provisioning of Prometheus/Grafana, log shipping (Fluent Bit / OTEL collector), dashboards and alerting for Private installs via Helm + Terraform modules, and adds CI coverage and upgrade/rollback playbooks. Scope: - Helm charts: kube-prometheus-stack pinned to verified version, Grafana provisioning jobs for customer dashboards and datasource templating, Alertmanager config template with templated receiver stubs. - Terraform: new monitoring module (terraform/modules/monitoring) that provisions monitoring namespace, serviceAccount bindings, and optional remote-write resources for hosted metrics. - Log shipping: Fluent Bit helm values + OTEL collector config to forward logs and traces to either customer-managed endpoints or Redwood-hosted endpoints (configurable via vars). - Dashboards & alerts: set of curated Grafana dashboards (system, model-serving, request-rate/latency/cost) and alerting rules tuned for Private environments (lower cardinality and SLO-aware thresholds). - Upgrade/rollback: adds a canary upgrade job and a scripted rollback path using Helm release hooks and Terraform state promotion notes. - CI: helm linting, terraform validate/plan (with mocked provider), and an integration job that deploys the chart into a KinD cluster and runs smoke checks. Checklist: - [x] Helm charts and values examples - [x] Terraform module with usage docs - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON templates (sanitized) - [x] Alertmanager/PrometheusRule templates - [x] Integration tests (smoke) - [x] Upgrade/rollback playbook in docs Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve the current installer behavior (monitoring disabled). Operators must opt-in via terraform var enable_monitoring=true or helm values. Rollout notes: 1) Enable in a staging private install and validate dashboards/alerts with canary traffic. 2) Review remote-write and credentials policy with security/compliance before enabling production remote-write. 3) To rollback, run terraform apply with previous state and helm rollback <release> to previous revision. Security: secrets required for remote endpoints are only referenced via Kubernetes Secret or external KMS; documented in the module README. Known limitations: - Grafana dashboard JSONs are sanitized and omit customer-specific queries; customers will need to tweak datasource settings. - OTEL collector config is generic; some on-prem logging stacks may require custom processors. Related: ENG-4321 (monitoring baseline for private installs), OPS-721 (alert tuning), SUP-1123 (customer support case motivating remote-write feature).

release_notes: Add optional, opt-in monitoring automation for Private installs (Prometheus/Grafana).
Provide Terraform module to provision monitoring namespace and RBAC for Private installs.
Add Fluent Bit and OpenTelemetry Collector configs to support log and trace shipping for Private installs.
Include curated Grafana dashboards and default alerting rules tuned for Private environments.
CI coverage for helm linting, terraform validate and a monitoring smoke integration test.
upgrade_instructions: To enable monitoring in an existing Private install: 1) Add 'module "monitoring" { source = "./terraform/modules/monitoring" enable_monitoring = true }' to your terraform, run 'terraform plan' and 'terraform apply'. 2) Deploy the helm chart via 'helm upgrade --install monitoring ./helm/charts/monitoring -f values.yaml'. 3) Validate dashboards in Grafana and verify Prometheus targets. For rollback: 'helm rollback monitoring <revision>' and restore previous terraform state using terraform state commands or run 'terraform apply' with the previous configuration. See docs/private/upgrade-rollback.md for playbook and runbook steps.
